newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain shares keep to upward path in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain shares keep to upward path in week.

text.p: Bahrain's share index continued its upward path in the week to Thursday, ending 10.08 points higher at a record 1,806.63 points.
In moderate turnover focused on banks and investment companies the index was half a percent higher than last week's 1,796.55 point close.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange said around 11 million shares worth 2.67 million dinars ($7 million) changed hands in the week, down on the 14.7 million shares worth 3.2 million dinars the previous week.
Shares of 25 of the 40 firms listed on the exchange were traded in 390 transactions.
The bourse said Bahrain Middle East Bank led the market with 3.9 million shares worth 652,704 dinars changing hands. It ended two fils lower at 167 fils.
Shares of Investcorp rose one U.S. cent to $2.18, National Bank of Bahrain edged up two fils to 424 fils and United Gulf Bank rose two fils to 167 fils.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank dropped two fils to 348 fils. Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait was also two fils weaker at 208 fils.
Bahrain International Bank was steady at 184 fils.
